documents.title: Label form controls
documents.reuse_notes: Original short paraphrase with attribution; consult source for authoritative guidance. No complete source document copied.
documents.text: Associate every form control with a descriptive label. A visible label connected to the control helps people identify the expected input. Check the accessible name in automated results and manually inspect the interface.

documents.title: Bound responsive layouts
documents.reuse_notes: Original short paraphrase with attribution; no complete source document copied.
documents.text: Layout calculations can be costly for large pages. Keep layout complexity bounded, measure actual browser behavior, and avoid unnecessary repeated layout work. Validate the page at each documented viewport.

documents.title: Local sample: preserve business facts
documents.reuse_notes: SiteProof-authored local sample guidance; not an external standard.
documents.text: Preserve captured phone numbers, email addresses, services, opening hours, and prices exactly. Require a recorded user correction to change a business fact. Never invent testimonials, credentials, customers, or awards.

documents.title: Local sample: verification boundaries
documents.reuse_notes: SiteProof-authored local sample guidance; not an external standard.
documents.text: A redesign hypothesis is not a proven conversion defect. Run equivalent before and after checks. An unavailable executable check remains unverified, and a failed check cannot be overridden by a model opinion. Automated accessibility checks do not establish WCAG compliance.
